readme.summary: Well-structured documentation with thorough installation options and good CLI reference, but the Examples section appears truncated and troubleshooting is absent.
readme.top_issue: The Examples section is cut off mid-sentence, leaving common use cases (html, junit, cobertura, xml output) undocumented despite being core features.

common_complaints: Test failure reporting issues (session-level failures, parameterized test handling)
Coverage calculation discrepancies (closures excluded, SonarQube integration failures)
Compatibility issues with newer Xcode versions
Missing output format options (JSON, multi-configuration support)
praise_themes: Project quality and usefulness acknowledged ('thanks for the great project')
sentiment.summary: Moderately healthy project with legitimate unresolved bugs in core functionality (test/coverage reporting) and patchy maintainer responsiveness; recent activity evident but multiple open issues from past months suggest bandwidth constraints rather than abandonment.
